text: can you give walls the same thickness of the wall piece paper_wall
resolution: Set the standard wall depth to the user's Studio paper_wall thickness (0.005m) in catalog.ts WALL_SIZE. Walls are centered on their grid line (req_1714/1719), so the thinner slab is symmetric about the line — existing walls thin in place, no data migration. The fat face-slab sandwich can't render a 5mm wall (its 0.02 plates float outside with gaps), so pieceShapes.addWallBox now renders a thin wall as two half-depth boxes meeting at the centerline (front+back), keeping per-side paint; the fat path stays for any thick wall. Made the wall tests thickness-relative (wallSlabs reads .front + catalog depth; placed uses halfDepth; REQ-0109 assertEqual→assertClose since 0.005 isn't dyadic; ramp-trim asserts the sub-threshold overhang; worldGeometry expects 2 boxes). wallSlabs 3/3, worldParity 16/16, roofs 9/9 green.
